prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1035; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the incident you reported involving your vehicle. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me where you were when the accident happened.

A: I was driving in Conroe, Texas, on the main road heading toward the shopping center. I was in the right lane and needed to move left to get over for my exit.

Q: What did you do before you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my left shoulder. I didn't see anything right beside me, so I put on my signal and started to move over.

Q: What happened next?

A: About halfway into the lane change, I felt a hard bump on the driver's side. The other car had been in my blind spot and it scraped along my door. Both of us pulled over onto the shoulder.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?

A: No, I didn't. I only saw it after we touched, when I looked over and saw it right there.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck jerked to the side when the impact happened, and by that evening it was stiff and sore. I've been having pain when I turn my head and some tightness across my shoulders.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for your neck?

A: I went to urgent care the next day and they diagnosed a neck strain. I've been doing the exercises they gave me and I'm taking over-the-counter pain medication.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my medical bills get taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
